protocol.cohort: All 21 remaining parents from existing held-out cohort; three per original system; 84 original/large x Gaussian/corrupted cases; frozen cameras, sigma .01, repetition 0; no selection on results
protocol.primary: Sonnet split-minus-Huber majority-vote accuracy on 84 extension cases, parent-cluster bootstrap; original 28 and pooled 112 reported separately
protocol.secondary: Identical numerical readout at .02 angstrom and 5 degrees, coordinate RMSD, maximum atomic error, original accuracy, stable-changed accuracy, paired joint accuracy, false restoration, Gaussian and corrupted subsets
protocol.controls: User requested lattice-only during the two-reconstruction run; add all 21 parent lattices, same wording and three-response vote; no new exact-coordinate calls. Original exact controls retained.
protocol.format: Same instruction and eight-decimal species-sorted fractional coordinates as pilot; no target, method, parent identifier or numerical readout in prompt
protocol.voting: Three responses per distinct input; most common valid answer, ties by earliest occurrence; all-invalid is incorrect; identical input shares its responses
protocol.retry: No automatic retry; truncations and malformed answers are retained as invalid; unknown billing reserves full charge and stops
protocol.cache: Explicit final text block 5-minute TTL; sequential repeats per input; audit actual reads
protocol.budget: Full conservative reservation per request; complete parent-block admission; previous pilot spend plus new spend plus pending or unknown charges never above 35; stop by cost, never accuracy
protocol.target_definition: Unperturbed reference structure numerical class at the prompt tolerance .02 angstrom and 5 degrees; archived benchmark_label retained. Two large-variant cases from unstable parent mp-865981 have reference monoclinic versus archived triclinic; resolved before any paid calls, no exclusions.
